mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate revenues.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 3.5% signals an extremely tight labor market, which typically precedes wage inflation and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 3.5%), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past month signals strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining UNRATE are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 1.25 million units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate revenues.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1250.0), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a severe supply-side shock combined with weakening demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
